item.tib: drag sngags gsang ba'i spu gri las phyag gzhes gsal byed me long
item.coloph: zhes pa'i gsang phur gyi phyag bzhes gsal byed shel dkar me long 'di ni rje btsun ma gter grogs dbang mo dang / mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang po/ spyi dpon nor bu rgyal mtshan rang slob g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor/ gshen gyi dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa dbal khyung bon gter ram gsang sngags gling pas bris pas/ dge des g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun du dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
